about: Named scopes for the ops-write catalogue-import runbook (scripts/ops/catalogue_import.py). A scope is what one run plans: coded Bandai JP series ids (series), uncoded product names exactly as Bandai's 入手情報 writes them (uncoded_products), or every product named inside uncoded catch-all series (uncoded_series, minus exclude_products); asia_en_measure also reads Bandai's Asia-EN catalogue. Adding or changing a scope is a reviewed PR. Uncoded products are reported against the evidence standard (app.services.uncoded_product_evidence) but not imported until the owner settles the Asia-EN evidence question (Phase 2 step C).

eb-05.note: Phase 2 step B: EB-05 ONE PIECE Heroines Edition vol.2 (coded, series 550205).

family-deck-set.note: Phase 2 step B: Family Deck Set (series 550701). Its product name equals its catch-all series name, so the evidence report is expected to name rule not_a_catchall for the owner to decide.
